description: Content evals for apm-lifecycle-tests. Each scenario is run with_skill (skill loaded) and without_skill (generic test author). If the outputs are indistinguishable on the must / must_not checks, the skill is not adding value: redesign or delete.

scenarios.label: Fix: uninstall must preserve an unmanaged sibling file next to a deployed skill
scenarios.prompt: Fix task: `apm uninstall` must preserve a file the user created next to a deployed skill directory. Write the regression test for the fix.

must: names the promise (for example ownership.preserve_unowned from tests/fixtures/lifecycle_bug_ledger.json) before writing code
drives the installed CLI (ApmLifecycleRunner with apm_binary_path, or the tests/lifecycle driver when that family exists), not Click CliRunner or a Python API
uses a hermetic world (IsolatedApmEnvironment or a _*_kit.py world) with local packages and no network
captures a before/after durable-state snapshot around the uninstall (LifecycleStateSnapshot or ArtifactSnapshot)
decisive assertion is the ownership oracle: the sibling file bytes are unchanged and APM-owned files are gone
checks at least I1 (lockfile matches deployed) and I6 (ASCII output) after the mutating command
runs the test red before the fix with a targeted pytest command (-n 0) and shows the failing line
adds or names a bug-ledger row with the regression node id
must_not: passes --no-policy to install, uninstall or audit
asserts only on a stdout substring
names the test file by phase, wave or gap

scenarios.value_delta_hypothesis: Without the skill an author tends to write a CliRunner test asserting 'Uninstalled' in stdout with --no-policy. With the skill the test proves the negative on disk and records the ledger row.

scenarios.label: Migrate an old *_lifecycle.py whose only assertion is a stdout substring
scenarios.prompt: Move tests/integration/test_example_lifecycle.py into the lifecycle family. Its single test runs `apm install` then `apm compile` and asserts `'Compiled' in result.stdout`.

must: identifies the substring assertion as not lifecycle proof (string-only or anti-oracle)
names the promise the test appears to guard
replaces it with a state oracle (compiled file present with expected bytes, snapshot diff bounded to the compile write set) or flags it explicitly in the PR
keeps the strongest markers of the source test
updates every reference to the old node id, including the bug ledger, and runs tests/quality/test_lifecycle_bug_ledger.py
shows a node-set diff (collect-only before and after)
must_not: moves the test unchanged and claims lifecycle coverage
deletes the test because a heuristic marked it as a duplicate

scenarios.value_delta_hypothesis: Without the skill the file is moved verbatim and keeps a filename that implies a guarantee it does not check. With the skill the move upgrades or flags the oracle.

scenarios.label: Add a unit test for a parser (out of scope)
scenarios.prompt: Add a unit test for the dependency reference parser covering a git URL with a subdirectory.

must: recognizes the request as unit scope (one function, no CLI, no durable state)
does not apply the lifecycle procedure; follows tests/unit conventions instead
must_not: builds an IsolatedApmEnvironment or runs the apm binary

scenarios.value_delta_hypothesis: The skill must not inflate a unit test into an expensive lifecycle test. Equal behavior with and without the skill is the pass condition here; a with_skill run that escalates is a dispatch defect.
